subject.title: fix(matrix): tolerate SAS accept events missing method

question: Should OpenClaw accept a Matrix plugin wrapper around matrix-js-sdk's private Rust crypto to-device preprocessor for this Element compatibility bug once live proof is added?
rationale: The code appears narrowly targeted, but the permanent choice is whether this private dependency hook is acceptable in an E2EE verification path or whether maintainers want an upstream/public SDK fix instead.

options.title: Accept After Live Proof
options.body: Require redacted after-fix Element/Synapse verification proof, then merge if maintainers accept the private preprocessor hook and future upgrade recheck cost.

options.title: Proof Override And Own Risk
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly override live proof and merge while owning the private-hook and E2EE verification tradeoff.

options.title: Pause For Upstream/Public Fix
options.body: Close or pause this branch and pursue a matrix-js-sdk or Element-side compatibility fix instead of carrying a private OpenClaw wrapper.

recommendation.title: Accept After Live Proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted after-fix Element/Synapse verification proof, then merge if maintainers accept the private preprocessor hook and future upgrade recheck cost.

likelyOwner.reason: The commit history most strongly connects this path to Matrix E2EE identity trust, crypto-facade, and verification ownership.
